# Stacks Index

> Stacks are compiled pages that document how a coherent set of layered or
> interlocking components fits together — a technology stack, toolchain, or
> assembled system — synthesized from raw sources. They sit alongside concepts,
> topics, and references as a compiled-article category. Stack pages use
> `category: stack` and link out to the concepts, topics, and references that
> describe each layer.
